title: Coordinate Grid Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Faces
description: Demonstrate the mapping between a screen position and its (x, y) coordinate pair by clicking anywhere on a simulated pixel grid, and identify the origin, X axis direction, and Y axis direction when they are toggled into view.

learningObjectives: Demonstrate the mapping between a screen position and its (x, y) coordinate pair by clicking anywhere on a simulated pixel grid, and identify the origin, X axis direction, and Y axis direction when they are toggled into view.
